title: process::exit in kithctl library functions prevents clean error handling
description: config.rs:18-20 and watch.rs:507-508 call std::process::exit(1) from inside library functions (Config::from_env and jmap_post). Library functions must return Err, not exit the process — they bypass all RAII destructors including terminal cleanup, prevent callers from handling the error, and make the functions untestable without mocking process::exit. Return Result and let main/cmd_watch decide to exit.
